title: org.ligatureprotocol.message
description: DRAFT. Messages on a QUIC stream (ADR 0036). A frame is a 4-byte big-endian length followed by one CBOR map carrying a reverse-DNS type. The first frame on every stream is the stream header; the gossip stream then carries have, want and fact messages. Decoders ignore unknown fields. The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

typeName.description: A reverse-DNS type name such as org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

factId.description: A fact identifier: the SHA-256 of the envelope's payload bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters in JSON and a 32-byte string in CBOR.

streamHeader.description: The first frame on every stream. Names what the stream is for.

purpose.description: gossip, manifest, or the capability type the stream carries. A receiver that does not understand the purpose closes the stream with application error code 1.

gossipHave.description: The fact identifiers this side holds. Sent by both sides once the gossip stream is open.

gossipWant.description: The fact identifiers this side lacks and asks for.

gossipFact.description: One signed fact. Revocations and abandonments are sent before anything else; the receiver verifies the envelope before storing it.
